svg.title: Сведение рук в кроссовере снизу — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Correct RIGHT phase only. Both arms reach forward and slightly upward away from chest with almost straight elbows, hands meet in front at shoulder height. Show the forearms foreshortened from a 3/4 view. Currently elbows are bent too much and hands sit on chest; this is a fly, not a curl. Keep two low pulley cables connected. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
